title: Rabbah bar Beruna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 110a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.110a.6): the question was asked what “palm water” is. Rabbah bar Beruna said: “There are two palm trees in the West, and a spring of water comes out between them. The first cup loosens; the next one purges.”
Hyman explains that Yuchasin’s statement that he was Rav’s student refers to Rav Beruna, his father.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman quotes the effects of the first two cups. The linked Shabbat continues with a third. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3180&lang=en) also suggests that Yuchasin’s description as Rav’s pupil refers to Rav Beruna, the father.
